basic_info.description: Just in time for spring, this stunning 3 bed, 2.5 bath home delivers the ultimate indoor-outdoor lifestyle. The resort-style backyard is a true showstopper, featuring a heated pool with cascading water features, an integrated spa, Sonos-powered sound system, outdoor speakers, and a mounted TV - perfect for relaxing or entertaining year-round. Inside, Victorian charm meets bold designer style with a chef's kitchen, vibrant formal dining room and living room with Jean-Paul Gaultier wallpaper, and a luxurious primary suite featuring a private terrace and spa-like bath. Enjoy a private infrared sauna, multiple outdoor lounges, a landscaped garden, an attached garage, and two driveway spaces in one of San Francisco's sunniest neighborhoods. A rare, move-in-ready masterpiece where comfort, design, and lifestyle come together seamlessly.
